name: Balanced Scorecard
purpose: Connect strategic outcomes to a small coherent set of financial, customer, internal-process and learning measures.
use_when: Established business with an explicit strategic choice and cross-functional dependencies
do_not_use_when: Founder still testing whether a customer problem exists
Metric catalog without an agreed strategy
steps: Draft explicit hypotheses between outcomes and capabilities
interpretation: A map expresses hypotheses to test; attractive arrows do not prove causality.
common_mistakes: Treating perspectives as a score to average
limitations: No automatic causal proof or universal balanced weighting
